note: Physical values that are deliberately physical. Each entry needs a reason a reviewer can check; the checker fails on a missing reason and on an entry that no longer matches anything. Anything here that is really a layout bug must be made logical instead.

entries.reason: A `linear-gradient` direction has no logical keyword in CSS, so the scroll hint cannot say `to inline-end`. The value here is only the fallback for the custom property `applyDocumentLocale` sets on the document, which flips it to `to right` under Arabic.
